milestone: Per-component bounded acquisition-time estimates in the SONIC observation adapter
status: Software extension verified; real acquisition estimates and bounds remain unestablished
changes: SonicMeasuredState carries finite nonnegative absolute error bounds for body, left hand and right hand
Full acquisition intervals participate in freshness, skew and buffered-state expiry
Observations and measured-state status retain the oldest possible acquisition time
Invalid intervals cannot consume accepted-state sequence or timestamp markers
Exact-time callers retain zero-uncertainty behavior; zero does not represent unknown hardware uncertainty

initial_red_run.reason: New acquisition_uncertainty_seconds field absent before implementation
initial_red_run.note: Two additional overflow/rejected-sequence cases were added after this red capture

checks.known_warning: Existing pytest startup subprocess ResourceWarning, retained in pytest.log

review.scope: Design and final source review of four Python files; no tests or hardware actions

findings: StateSubscriber.latest records local receipt time; age() measures time since receipt
LiveImages._recv retains latest decoded images without propagating acquisition metadata into pairing

limits: Absolute bounds require producer provenance; short-trace statistics or arbitrary margins are insufficient
Increasing component estimates do not prove actual sample order when their intervals overlap
Producers must preserve estimates and bounds for cached samples; restamping is not detected from values alone
Camera and body/hand timing bounds, physical finger mapping and task framing remain uncommissioned
No live service observations, policy predictions or bottle-to-tray success established by this step
next_step: Establish body/hand acquisition provenance or defensible bounds at the real source, then connect and validate the measured-state producer
